summary: xAI announced that Gopuff has integrated Grok's text, audio, and image models into a new in-app shopping assistant called Go, launching first in the US.

mechanisms.reason: Grok models are deployed into a consumer delivery app used for shopping, which would add to aggregate inference calls, though no volume figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: Go is available now in the Gopuff app on iOS and Android, starting in the US with the UK to follow.

categories.reason: A consumer delivery marketplace is embedding an AI agent into its core shopping and ordering flow, changing its product economics.
categories.quote: Gopuff and SpaceXAI launched Go, an AI-powered shopping assistant built into the Gopuff app and powered by Grok text, audio, and image models.
